text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume who had continually achieved 
great results in their respective 
generations and stepped away from racing 
have all returned at once to the fierce 
fray—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the "era of the strongest" begins, 
Eishin Flash shows signs of impatience. 
Her mistakes become noticeable even during 
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, she wouldn't be able to keep 
her promise to her parents to keep winning 
all the way to the "Tenno Sho (Autumn)." 
Convinced of this, Eishin Flash—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Instead of the expected fierce battle of a 
GⅠ, she brings a conservative revised 
schedule aimed at securing guaranteed 
victories in GⅡ and GⅢ races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sensing her fear of failure, the Trainer 
turns to Smart Falcon for advice to ease 
the troubled girl's mind.
